Priya K: Planning a short maintenance window for rack saturn-7 (us-east1) Thu 01:30 UTC. Scope: graceful kernel minor update + NIC qdisc tweak. Window ~75m.
Ben S: Are we touching any dedicated tenant slices?
Priya K: No dedicated pins. Two internal canaries live there. We'll drain canary-01 first and verify.
Luca M: Backfill plan? last time we had cold kv-cache on promoted nodes.
Priya K: Promote standby-saturn (adds 4 GPUs). We'll run a 10m kvseed on each backfill node prior to draining. Cadence: 1 node every 4 min.
Ben S: Cost impact estimate? ops budget ok?
Priya K: Rough: 4 A10 GPUs * 0.6 USD/hr * 1.25hr ~= 3 USD. Ops will absorb.
Luca M: Canary gating manual?
Priya K: Manual gate. Smoke checks: p95 latency, model error-rate, gpu temp. If fail, abort.
ops-bot: Maintenance scheduled by Priya K: saturn-7 nic-kernel-tweak - Thu 01:30 UTC.
Ben S: I'll be online for the window. Post 10m and 1m reminders.
Priya K: Will do. Drain snippet for SRE: `kubectl cordon $NODE && kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600`.
Luca M: Enabling conservative batching and suppressing eviction noise alerts during window.
Priya K: Good. Postmortem: brief latency regression test and one-paragraph summary to #incidents if any anomaly. :)
